items.title: Kelly Clarkson’s expensive purchases: A multi-million dollar real-estate portfolio that spans the country
items.description: From a sprawling waterfront mansion in Tennessee and a lavish California estate to a cozy Montana ranch, Kelly Clarkson is no stranger to expensive purchases.

items.title: The Beach Boys’ Mike Love goes the extra mile to protect the land around $43 million Lake Tahoe estate
items.description: Beach Boys star Mike Love has revealed the extraordinary lengths he went to preserve the natural beauty surrounding his sprawling $43 million Lake Tahoe estate.

items.title: My wife says we can’t afford to retire. I vetoed her $8,000 trip to Italy. We’re in our 60s and have $4 million. Do I keep working?
items.description: “I worry about healthcare, long-term care, inflation, a long bear market and living to 95.”

items.title: ‘Some people did everything right’: I lost my home in the Great Recession. I rent in my 50s. Why is that judged as failure?
My sister moved in with our mother, 78, and says she deserves the $925,000 family home. Is she right?
items.description: “The house is worth $925,000 and mom owns it outright. She also has $480,000 in investments.”

items.title: I’m 64 with two sons, but only one works in the family business. Is it ethical to leave him 70% of the company?
items.description: “I have some reservations about the long-term stability of my younger son’s marriage.”

items.title: I’m 63 and diagnosed with lymphoma. Should I take my Social Security next year?
items.description: “My plan is to continue working as long as I’m able to do so and invest my Social Security benefits while I’m still earning a paycheck.”

items.title: These surprising stocks could be some of the biggest drivers of S&P 500 earnings growth
items.description: Boeing, Meta and EchoStar recorded steep charges and expenses a year ago, which are expected to make this latest quarter’s results look especially strong by comparison.

items.title: Stocks are heading for a high-stakes showdown, as strong earnings collide with rising borrowing costs
items.description: The idea that the AI trade has been mostly immune to rising bond yields isn’t quite right, one strategist notes.

items.title: There is a silent market rotation inside the S&P 500 that’s warning of more weakness ahead
items.description: A “triple-top” reversal chart pattern is pointing to a period of underperformance for the S&P 500 — perhaps a long one.
